_comment: Scenario-staged ROLL_THE_LINE demo: a full-strength (120) player Infantry unit is ordered under the roll-the-line stance to attack a lone weak (15-man, low-morale) enemy at the front of a line of three. As each enemy in turn breaks and routs, the attacker automatically rolls onto the next-closest enemy still fighting -- no fresh order issued for the second or third target. Camera holds on the line so the sequential engagement reads clearly.

facing_flutter.reason: Tracked in #1764: a pre-existing sub-degree facing sawtooth (about 0.25 degrees, period 2-4 ticks) while uid 3 marches up behind uid 1, which main shows too. With every tick from 61 to 540 sampled on both trees, main reads uid 3 at 6 reversals in a row and this branch at 13 (threshold 3); a temporary exact-facing print measured the same amplitude on both (main ticks 220-249, this branch ticks 154-176). The local 2-tick dense delta from the divergence tick read 7 here against 2 on main. Uid 3 never reflects its grid; it marches behind uid 1, whose men now keep their flanks after uid 1's re-square at tick 62, so it meets a differently shaped block ahead.
